state: JevCode iteration planning, round 4 (post-playground). Previous rounds decided: iteration 1 = experience infra, which shipped as /{lang}/playground/ with 5 scenarios (noul/choice/score/composite/fanout), pre-recorded real jev-1.13.0 responses, gen-vs-judgment side-by-side, top nav entry in all 8 languages, all internal links verified zero-404, astro check clean, 338 pages built. Now deciding iteration 2. Previously deferred candidates: S1 client-side search (Jev scored value 0.86 in round 1 but not chosen for iteration 1); W4 comparison article series 'Jev vs generative LLM stack' (0.62/0.33); W3 machine-translation trust pass (0.54); W6 i18n fallback edge fixes (0.34). New candidate: N1 deploy the current state to production now (site runs on a VPS with atomic symlink deploy, previously deployed version is older and lacks: en-fallback change, 36 new case docs, playground). N2 content depth: the 5 playground scenarios reference cookbook pages; 2 of them (llm-guardrails, parallel-questions) exist only in zh/en, other 6 languages fall back to English. N3 SEO: sitemap exists, but no per-page structured data for the playground. Constraints: solo dev, static site, want to ship a release this session then decide whether to add more content in a follow-up loop. Questions: Should we deploy now before starting iteration 2 work, or bundle iteration 2 features into the same release? What should iteration 2 be?
